system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
we employ a series of curated prompts
(see Appendix J) to step-by-step guide the teacher
model to simulate the workflow
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts per role; mechanism not detailed.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
we utilize E5 (Wang
et al., 2022) as the embedding model and the
2018 Wikipedia dump (Karpukhin et al., 2020) as
the retrieval corpus, retrieving the top-5 passages.
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value is embedding_rag actually; dense E5 retriever — should be embedding_rag.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: the Purifier evaluates retrieval relevance and distills key information for the Reasoner
context_compaction.note: Purifier condenses retrieved documents before they enter Reasoner context.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
A retriever returns candidate documents
based on the query.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
the model must wrap the initial plan
with <plan></plan> tags, the revised plan with
<replan></replan> tags, and the final answer
with <answer></answer> tags

tool_count.evidence_quote:
The Reasoner is responsible for executing
core planning, reasoning, and invoking search tools.
tool_count.note: Only a search/retrieval tool is described.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote:
The Reasoner is responsible for executing
core planning, reasoning, and invoking search tools.
edit_primitive.note: QA domain; no file editing tools.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote:
D2PLAN comprises two agents: a Reasoner and a
Purifier.
protocol_standardization.note: No protocol mentioned anywhere in paper.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
the Reasoner constructs
explicit global plans during reasoning and dy-
namically adapts them based on retrieval feed-
back

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
multi-hop questions are decomposed into an ordered sequence
of sub-questions to form an initial plan

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
These documents are not di-
rectly passed to the Reasoner, but first analyzed
by the Purifier.
multi_agent_topology.note: Two specialised agents in a fixed hand-off; could also be read as orchestrator_workers.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
The purified information
and relevance judgment are then fed back to the
Reasoner, enabling it to adapt the global plan and
continue reasoning.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote:
the Reasoner autonomously con-
structs a global plan (i.e., an ordered sequence of
sub-questions), sequentially addresses each sub-
question

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
the Reasoner refines the subsequent
sub-question based on the resolved context
short_term_state.note: Plan of sub-questions maintained across steps.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote:
given an input question, the Reasoner au-
tonomously assesses its complexity and constructs
a global problem-solving plan.

state_persistence.evidence_quote:
given an input question, the Reasoner au-
tonomously assesses its complexity and constructs
a global problem-solving plan.

self_verification.evidence_quote:
the Purifier focuses on assessing
whether the candidate documents contain key in-
formation for solving the target sub-question.
self_verification.note: A second model judges retrieval relevance; could also be read as llm_judge.

retry_policy.evidence_quote:
continuing until relevant
evidence is obtained or the maximum number of
attempts K is reached
retry_policy.note: Retries are retrieval attempts per sub-question.

rollback.evidence_quote:
the Reasoner revises the
remaining sub-questions, including the current un-
solved one, to explore alternative problem-solving
paths for self-correction.
rollback.note: Plan revision, not environment rollback; no state to revert.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
continuing until relevant
evidence is obtained or the maximum number of
attempts K is reached

cost_controls.evidence_quote:
Under the same computational
budget, experiments show that using Qwen2.5-
7B-SFT as the Purifier reduces total inference
time from 432s to 381s

timeouts.evidence_quote:
Under the same computational
budget, experiments show that using Qwen2.5-
7B-SFT as the Purifier reduces total inference
time from 432s to 381s

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
For retrieval, we utilize E5 (Wang
et al., 2022) as the embedding model and the
2018 Wikipedia dump (Karpukhin et al., 2020) as
the retrieval corpus
execution_isolation.note: Only a local retriever call; no code execution sandbox.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote:
we
employ a local dense retriever (E5) with a static
Wikipedia corpus
filesystem_access.note: Agent only reads a static corpus.

network_policy.evidence_quote:
we
employ a local dense retriever (E5) with a static
Wikipedia corpus rather than more powerful re-
trieval systems such as commercial search engines
(e.g., Google).

permission_model.evidence_quote:
When invoking search tools, the Reasoner gener-
ates a query and specifies the target sub-question to
be solved.

tracing.evidence_quote:
Through this process, we
obtain a set of reasoning trajectories synthesized ac-
cording to the D2PLAN workflow.

replayability.evidence_quote:
We reproduce
the inference results of all baseline methods under
the same environment to ensure fair comparison.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote:
For evaluation metrics, we
employ Exact Match (EM) and LLM-as-a-Judge
(LasJ). For LasJ, we utilize qwen-plus
eval_hooks.note: Evaluation pipeline described in the paper; no repo available to verify.

guardrails.evidence_quote:
If
relevant information exists, the Purifier extracts it
precisely; otherwise, it provides a brief summary of
the retrieved documents.
guardrails.note: Purifier filters retrieved content entering the Reasoner's context; not a safety guardrail.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote:
We employ Qwen2.5-
3B/7B-Instruct (Qwen et al., 2025) as the back-
bone models.
model_agnostic.note: Requires SFT+RL-trained backbones, not any provider model.
